KNOWN DIVERGENCE (residual, §7): tag suffix with [ ] — TS INVALID (npm tag scanner stops at '[') vs Oracle VALID (PyYAML URI charset includes [ ]). Needs an Oracle-side rejection of [ ] in tag suffixes; out of scope.
